changelog:
v3.6.2 — 71% smaller downloads

• APK size cut from 190MB → 55MB (arm64) / 51MB (armeabi) by shipping per-architecture builds and dropping x86/x86_64 native libs. Every real streaming device (Fire TV, Ooustick, Shield) is ARM — x86 was dead weight from libVLC and FFmpeg.
• In-app updater now picks the right APK for your device automatically. v3.6.0 users stuck on the old 100MB download cap can finally OTA-update — v3.6.2 fits under the limit.
• Unchanged: MKV playback, Media3 1.9.0, MultiView MTK gating, all other v3.6.0/v3.6.1 fixes.
